description: Ministry of Power & Renewable Energy - Order made to approve the acquisition of lands, Manjapaanjan, Keelaiyankudiiruppu Kavuruvankithoddam, Mannar D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains an order approving the acquisition of specific lands (with detailed descriptions, boundaries, and extents) required by the Ceylon Electricity Board. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government-related type.
